messages: anya: Quick thread design review for playground streaming. Trying a more action-oriented copy: "Halt" (pause client-side), "Kill" (server abort + free resources), and "Retry" (regenerate). Other asks: token display as a trailing chip in the composer (collapses to icon), preserved partials surface as an overlay card (user must apply to composer), and Prompt Shelf shortcut Ctrl+J. Figma: https://figma.com/redwood/playground-halt-kill ben: love the overlay card concept. Copy suggestions: "Halt (pause)", "Kill (stop & save)" is a *bit* strong; maybe "Kill" only for internal docs. For UI use "Stop (save partial)". Token chip: show live count, then animate to dot; show delta +N after Retry. maria: product constraints: Stop/Kill must not auto-send partials. Overlay has Apply / Dismiss / Revert actions. Retry runs against visible composer text (if user edited the partial) and creates a new history entry. We'll add a small inline note: "Running Retry on edited draft." sam: backend notes: Halt = client suspension (no server cancel), Kill = server cancel & emit final tokens_consumed with abort=true. We'll add generation.tag = [streaming, halted, killed, completed] and a preserve_hint when client saved partials. Token delta event emitted on completion or kill. Pause (halt) may need a keepalive ping to avoid websocket timeouts. linda: accessibility & keyboard: controls must be in tab order before composer; token chip must be focusable and use role=status + aria-live=polite. Overlay should trap focus and announce "Partial response available as draft. Press Apply to edit or Dismiss to close." Example snippet: ``` Tokens: 132 ``` linda: for screen reader feedback, announce token delta: "Generation used 42 tokens." Also ensure Prompt Shelf items have descriptive labels and are reachable via keyboard. nick: QA notes: test overlay on small viewports, ensure it doesn't cover composer controls; test mix of Halt then Retry, and Kill during slow streams. Mobile: token chip compression should not hide the delta bubble. anya: action items: 1) ben update Figma with overlay + trailing token chip (ETA today), 2) sam spike tags + final-token event (2d), 3) maria write flow doc for apply/dismiss/retry (1d), 4) linda draft A11y phrases + keyboard map (2d), 5) nick add QA cases and mobile viewport checks (3d). I'll book a 25m review Fri 9:30am PT. deploy-bot: Reminder: "Playground streaming micro-review" Fri 09:30 PT. React with :+1: if attending. anya: thanks team leaving thread open for quick follow-ups.
